ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85% high-intensity (white) pixels in central regions vs 15% low-intensity (black) pixels at margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white regions on both lobes; black pigmentation localized to a thick band along the trailing edge and distal tips. Small dark focal spots are scattered across the white field, with a higher concentration near the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an approximate interior angle of 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrations along the entire visible trailing edge; high-amplitude jagged peaks are concentrated at the far-left distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a concave sweep from the median notch towards the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, dark roughly circular pixel clusters distributed across the white ventral field, particularly prominent on the inner portion of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned vertical dark linear marks visible on the white field of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct irregular indentation/notch on the trailing edge of the right lobe; the left tip exhibits a bulbous, high-contrast black textured mass.
other_distinctive_markers: The leading edge and lower sections of the ventral fluke are occluded by water spray/splashing.
